description: This file implements the Http2DecoderAdapter class, which handles decoding of HTTP/2 frames, including parsing headers, data frames, settings, push promises, pings, and other control frames. It manages state transitions, error handling, and communicates with visitor interfaces for processing decoded frames.

classes.name: Http2DecoderAdapter
classes.description: A class that decodes HTTP/2 frames, manages decoding state, error handling, and communicates with visitor interfaces for processing frames.

methods.name: StateToString
methods.description: Converts internal decoder state enum to string for debugging.

methods.name: SpdyFramerErrorToString
methods.description: Converts SpdyFramerError enum to string for debugging.

methods.name: Http2DecoderAdapter()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder and corrupting frame headers for debug.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data buffer, decoding frames until all data is consumed or an error occurs.

methods.name: probable_http_response
methods.description: Indicates if a probable HTTP response was detected.

methods.name: StopProcessing
methods.description: Stops further processing and reports an error.

methods.name: SetMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Sets maximum allowed frame size for decoding.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles the event when a frame header is decoded, performs validation and state updates.

methods.name: OnDataStart
methods.description: Handles start of a data frame.

methods.name: OnDataPayload
methods.description: Handles payload data of a data frame.

methods.name: OnDataEnd
methods.description: Handles end of a data frame.

methods.name: OnGoAwayOpaqueData
methods.description: Handles opaque data in GOAWAY frames.

methods.name: OnAltSvcOriginData

methods.name: OnAltSvcValueData
methods.description: Handles value data in ALTSVC frames.

methods.name: OnUnknownStart
methods.description: Handles start of unknown frame types.

methods.name: OnPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Handles error when padding is too long.

methods.name: ProcessInputFrame
methods.description: Decodes a single frame from input data.

methods.name: DetermineSpdyState
methods.description: Determines next decoder state after frame decoding.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if an error state is active.

methods.name: IsReadingPaddingLength

methods.name: IsDiscardingPayload

methods.name: IsOkToStartFrame

methods.name: HasRequiredStreamId
methods.description: Validates if stream ID meets requirements.

methods.name: HasRequiredStreamIdZero

methods.name: ReportReceiveCompressedFrame
methods.description: Reports reception of compressed frame to debug interface.

methods.name: GetHpackDecoder
